description: Use this when someone wants to know which visa or legal route lets them stay, live, move to, retire in or work remotely from Thailand, for example "how can I live in Thailand", "best visa to retire in Thailand", "which Thai visa do I need for a year", "moving to Thailand from the USA, which visa", "I am 45 with savings, can I stay long term", "DTV, LTR or Thailand Elite for me", "I am married to a Thai, how do I stay". It ranks the seven routes (30-day visa exemption plus extension, tourist visa, DTV digital nomad visa, Non-O retirement visa, Non-O marriage or Thai family visa, LTR 10-year visa, Thailand Privilege, formerly Thailand Elite) with the same rules as the Visa Map on thailandstayplan.com: whether each fits, why, what to watch, 5-year or per-trip cost, time, papers, insurance rule and sources with their check date, and names the education visa, work permit and permanent residence when they matter. Inputs: nationality as the user says it, age, planned stay, savings and income as numbers in Thai baht (convert other currencies at today's rate and tell the user), remote work, Thai spouse or child, budget. If nationality, age, stay or every money figure is missing it returns one question (scope needs_input): ask it, do not guess. Do not use for a question about one route's fees or documents (use thai_visa_details), for "do I need a visa for a holiday" (use thai_entry_check), for other countries' visas, flights or hotels. Information with sources, not legal advice; it recommends no agent, insurer or product.

age.description: Age in years. The retirement routes need 50 or over.

annual_passive_income_usd.description: Passive income per year in US dollars (pension, investments, rent), if known: the BOI LTR thresholds are USD 40,000 and USD 80,000 a year. Give monthly_income_thb as well.

budget.description: frugal = lowest cost even with more paperwork; standard = cost and effort balanced (default); premium = pays for zero paperwork.

monthly_income_thb.description: Regular income per month in Thai baht: pension, salary, rent, dividends. Convert at today's rate and say so. 0 if none.

nationality.description: Passport nationality as the user says it: country name, adjective or ISO code, e.g. "German", "United Kingdom", "US", "Australian", "Brazil". EU countries, the UK, the US, Canada, Australia and Japan are matched to the Visa Map groups; any other nationality is ranked as "other" and told to check the 60-country visa-exemption list.

remote_work.description: Will the user work remotely for a foreign employer or clients while in Thailand? Default false.

savings_thb.description: Savings the user could move to a Thai bank, in Thai baht. Convert other currencies at today's rate first and tell the user the rate you used. 0 if none.

stay.description: How long the user wants to stay in Thailand in total: under_30_days, 1_to_6_months, 6_to_12_months, or years (a year or more, indefinitely, retire, live there).

thai_family.description: Does the user have a Thai spouse or a Thai child? Default false.

name: which_thai_visa

other_routes.description: Routes the Visa Map does not rank (education, work, permanent residence), named when they may matter.

status.description: fits = the stated rules fit the answers; check_one_point = fits if one point in "watch" is confirmed; does_not_fit = a rule blocks it ("blocker").

url.description: Page on thailandstayplan.com for this route (information only).

scope.description: ranked = full answer; needs_input = ask the user the question first.

site_url.description: The Visa Map on thailandstayplan.com with these answers prefilled.

title: Which Thai visa fits me
